title_o: The Effects of Providing Therapists With Feedback on Patient Progress During Psychotherapy: Are Outcomes Enhanced?
evidence: Find study reports replicating Lambert et al. (2001) patient-progress feedback effect; cited original tests therapist feedback on patient outcomes.

title_o: Carving personality description at its joints: Confirmation of three replicable personality prototypes for both children and adults
evidence: Find full text says it assigns new samples to Asendorpf et al. (2001) aggregate ARC-type profiles and tests the prior study's kappa criterion; this source supplies the original DOI.

title_o: Subtyping Attention-Deficit/Hyperactivity Disorder Using Temperament Dimensions
evidence: Find abstract explicitly compares its irritable ADHD temperament profile against Karalunas et al. (2014); cited original defines those temperament subtypes.

title_o: An Evaluation of Instructive Feedback to Teach Play Behavior to a Child with Autism Spectrum Disorder
evidence: Find abstract explicitly says it replicated and extended Grow et al. (2016) using instructive feedback to teach play responses; original matches author, year, and procedure.

title_o: The impact bias in self and others: Affective and empathic forecasting in individuals with social anxiety
evidence: Find discussion explicitly says it replicated and extended Arditte Hall et al. (2018); original PubMed PMID 29758391 confirms the vignette, social-anxiety, and forecasting design.

title_o: Potential implications of the objectification of women's bodies for women's sexual satisfaction
evidence: Find title explicitly names Calogero and Thompson (2009), and its abstract retests the original self-surveillance to sexual-satisfaction pathway with new U.S. women.

title_o: Surveillance Cues Enhance Moral Condemnation
evidence: Find full text says its primary moral-judgment measure is that of Bourrat, Baumard, and McKay (2011), comparing eyes with flowers; the original tests that exact manipulation.

title_o: The negative testing effect and multifactor account
evidence: Find abstract says it examines the original negative-testing demonstration with a new population; cited 2013 original bears the named effect and account.

title_o: The Spreading of Disorder
evidence: Find reports two replications of the cross-norm effect; cited Keizer, Lindenberg, and Steg (2008) original tests whether one norm violation spreads to others.

title_o: Reassertion and giving up: The interactive role of self-directed attention and outcome expectancy
evidence: Find abstract tests the Carver self-awareness by success-expectancy interaction on persistence; cited original directly tests self-directed attention and outcome expectancy.

title_o: Resilient, overcontrolled, and undercontrolled boys: three replicable personality types
evidence: Find abstract explicitly says it fully replicated relations reported by Robins et al. (1996) between resilient, overcontrolled, and undercontrolled prototypes and the Big Five.

title_o: Perceived Extrinsic Mortality Risk and Reported Effort in Looking after Health
evidence: Find abstract explicitly says it replicated Pepper and Nettle (2014) on mortality risk and health effort; cached cited reference supplies this DOI and title.

title_o: Higher levels of (Internet) Gaming Disorder symptoms according to the WHO and APA frameworks associate with lower striatal volume
evidence: Find abstract says it replicates its authors' earlier negative IGD-symptom/striatal-volume association; original reports the same association in males.

title_o: Motivating goal-directed behavior through introspective self-talk: The role of the interrogative form of simple future tense
evidence: Find abstract explicitly names Senay et al. (2010) and repeats the interrogative versus declarative self-talk manipulation in six new studies.

title_o: Heart Strings and Purse Strings
evidence: Find abstract retests the 2004 misery-is-not-miserly sadness/spending effect; cached cited reference identifies the founding article by Lerner, Small, and Loewenstein.

title_o: Sight over sound in the judgment of music performance
evidence: Find abstract says it reproduces winner judgments from muted 6-second music-competition videos; the cited 2013 PNAS original uses that exact design.

evidence: Find full text says its new adult Study 5 is an extended replication of the adult part of Ambridge (2013), with larger participant and verb samples; original is this Cognitive Science article.

evidence: Thesis Study 1 explicitly attempts two replications of Yoon, Johnson and Csibra (2008) infant communication-induced memory bias.

evidence: Candidate tests the prior higher Jewish GFP and Jensen-effect findings of Dunkel et al. (2015) in new General Social Survey data.

evidence: Candidate thesis abstract states it tests Kinsbourne's (1972) verbal versus spatial question lateral-eye-movement predictions.

evidence: Published candidate version explicitly identifies Sun and Shek (2010) as the prior study and retests its positive-youth-development relation with later measurements.
